reason: I use AI all day at work and I've seen it be confidently wrong, so I'm not handing it my money, cute pet or not. And I'm not paying a monthly subscription to invest when my robo-adviser already rebalances for me.
objection: An AI agent making trades and payments with real money, run by a startup that doesn't even have its broker partner or price sorted yet. Limits and a kill switch don't fix the fact that it's a bot deciding what to do with my savings.
would_change_my_mind: A long, public track record on real money with a named, licensed broker holding the accounts, plus a free tier with no subscription.
